description: Black handwritten-style all-caps text, 'CAVEMAN EXPLAIN' upper and 'HOW GET GIRLFRIEND' lower, centred, large relative to portrait width.
Red bold caps 'MISSION:' centred upper; followed by black bold caps lines MAKE / WOMAN / LAUGH added one per step. Same typeface family as title but heavier.
Small grumpy man in bowler hat and bow tie holding a flower, yellow spotted vest. Seen only at opening.
Bearded caveman small centre with arms spread, mouth open, yellow spotted tunic. Face-open version G0002/G0003; face blank version G0004/G0005 (same body drawing re-used, face region altered).
Same shrug body but face features removed leaving white inside beard/hair; UNRESOLVED intent.
Full-height frowning caveman in plain white smock, arms hanging, bare feet. Re-used identical drawing, nipple marks added at G0008 onward.
Two small curved marks on chest of large caveman, added as overlay at 6.2s.
Caveman left, yellow tunic, angry open mouth, one palm raised, other hand pointing at easel.
Black tripod easel with white card captioned 'HOT?' and a small photo-style (non-line-art) image of a creature/figure; photographic texture differs from line-art style.
Black scribble-textured gorilla in yellow spotted tunic, round open mouth, fists at chest, small motion lines. Redrawn as an ape version of the yellow-tunic character; two frames identical.
Small caveman in yellow spotted tunic, arms up, frowning, falling pose. Single drawing translated along path (no pose change visible in strip).
Right-side tall rock cliff drawn with wavy black outline, white sky, no fill.
Bearded man in sunglasses and leather jacket with arm around woman in yellow spotted dress, small heart; hand-inked scribble ground line.
Seated screaming caveman typing at stone-block desk with CRT monitor; edges slightly smudged vs other clean frames.
Only recurring colour is yellow with black spots (tunics, dress); red used for 'MISSION:'; everything else black outline on white.
Plain white portrait canvas for all shots.
